meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在完成编辑操作后，如果收到评论检查器的警告，会先修复或解释被标记的评论，再继续后续工作。
howto.when: 当 Claude 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit、multi_edit 或 multiedit 等编辑操作后，评论检查器自动触发并可能发出警告时。

say.text: 修复刚才被标记的评论问题。
say.note: Claude 会检查并修正评论。

say.text: 解释一下为什么这条评论被警告。

howto.what_en: After installation, when Claude receives a warning from the comment checker after an edit, it will first fix or explain the flagged comment before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically after successful apply_patch, write, edit, multi_edit, or multiedit calls, when the comment checker emits a warning.

say_en.text: Fix the comment issue that was flagged.
say_en.note: Claude will check and fix the comment.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment was warned.
